name: Isonaga Sae
source:
One of the four sub-heroines. Takeru's teacher whose lessons are often called as lessons from hell.

[spoiler]She used have a boyfriend and was about get married with him, however, he died in a water-related accident, and thus, was majorly afflicted by it. Though she can handle anything to do with water, she doesn't want to have a sexual relationship with anyone.[/spoiler]
